newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Breeze loading 50,000 tonnes soymeal. Grl. Madalinsky loading 32,500 tonnes soymeal. Ossolineum loading 55,000 soybeans. Waiting to dock, five vessels to load soymeal and two for soybeans. Road: 990 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on June 3, 335 trucks with soymeal and 115 with vegetable oils, including soyoil.

Vessels: At public terminal, Panli loading 36,550 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, Pythagoras of Samo to load 36,000 tonnes soybeans and Marwick to load 27,000 tonnes soymeal. At Cargill private terminal, Lika loading 60,000 tonnes soymeal. No vessels waiting to dock.
Road: 197 trucks carrying 4,879 tonnes soybeans arrived on June 3 as well as 42 trucks with 1,003 tonnes soymeal.
Rail: 141 wagons arrived carrying 7,849 tonnes soybeans as well as 14 wagons with 725 tonnes soymeal.
